TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Enter the public site key for the games' managed Turnstile widget.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Enter its private Turnstile Siteverify secret.

TURN_KEY_ID.description: Enter the TURN Token ID from Cloudflare Realtime.

TURN_API_TOKEN.description: Enter the API key issued alongside that TURN Token ID.
